requirements.title: DECIMAL values are COMMA, or POINT
requirements.definition: The scalar default character expression in a DECIMAL= specifier shall evaluate to COMMA, or POINT.

pending.decimal-comma-value: Positive source/control uses DECIMAL="COMMA" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.decimal-point-value: Positive source/control uses DECIMAL="POINT" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.decimal-other-value-source-control: Source-control negative changes only the DECIMAL= value to an unlisted token such as "MAYBE"; no numbered diagnostic is claimed for this unnumbered value rule.

requirements.title: DECIMAL temporarily changes the connection decimal edit mode
requirements.definition: The DECIMAL= specifier temporarily changes the decimal edit mode for the connection.

pending.decimal-temporary-change: Use formatted input, or formatted output with SS sign mode, on a connection opened DECIMAL="POINT" and a statement DECIMAL="COMMA" with a decimal-comma real field chosen to avoid rounding ambiguity; post-statement INQUIRE(DECIMAL=; 12.10.2.7) prefilled with a sentinel must report POINT. Use the dual input control, or output control with SS sign mode, opened DECIMAL="COMMA" and a statement DECIMAL="POINT" with a point decimal real field; post-statement INQUIRE verifies restoration to COMMA.
pending.decimal-mode-restored-after-statement: The temporary-change plans explicitly pre-establish a nondefault connection mode with OPEN, perform one data transfer with a different statement specifier, and use post-transfer INQUIRE with a nonmatching sentinel to assert restoration rather than merely successful transfer.

requirements.title: Omitted DECIMAL leaves the connection decimal edit mode unchanged
requirements.definition: If the DECIMAL= specifier is omitted, the decimal edit mode is not changed.

pending.omitted-decimal-does-not-change-mode: Open with DECIMAL="COMMA", prefill INQUIRE variable with a sentinel, perform transfer omitting DECIMAL=, then INQUIRE(DECIMAL=; 12.10.2.7) and expect COMMA.

accounting.rationale: Single paragraph mixes DECIMAL= value restriction, temporary mode effect/restoration, and omitted-specifier no-change rule.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.2.2-12.6.2.16, the individual io-control-spec specifiers (batch160). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Each temporary mode specifier is split into its value restriction, its one-statement effect with restoration of the connection mode (observed by INQUIRE after the statement), and the omitted-means-unchanged rule. Round 1 found a pending plan expecting exact output from I2 on a positive value without fixing the sign mode; it now uses SS, and a sweep found no other plus-, leading-zero- or rounding-dependent exact output. R1215 and C1232 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
